purpose: Machine-readable naming authority for active Abbott governance/runtime surfaces. Historical archives preserve original wording; active authority uses canonical names.

rules.notes: North Star §2.11b/§2.11c establishes Conductor as the current supervisory role. Legacy code identifiers containing chair may remain temporarily for compatibility but must not be presented as current governance terminology.
Abbott is the nickname for the original BuilderOS after the second independent BuilderOS was created. Abbott remains an independent system from BuilderOS 2 / Costello.
Costello is the nickname for the second independent BuilderOS, built from a later blueprint informed by lessons from BuilderOS 1 / Abbott.
